digest.component_or_area: duration probe CLI and statistical framework
propositions: The duration probe must be refactored into a thin CLI layer (rebar_duration_probe.py) and a reusable support module (rebar_duration_probe_support.py) to stay within stdlib-only constraints and the 800-line canonical cap.

Gated-close phase breakdown must report pre-verifier residual, deterministic verifier, LLM verifier, and verdict-to-status intervals, with each phase labeled as direct metric, direct event, or inferred residual.
The probe must distinguish no-LLM operations, forced/status/check/help operations, unmatched operations, and interrupted operations from completed model-backed cohorts.
CLI arguments (--log-root, --tracker, --since, --until, --provider-prefix, --current-since) must have repository-neutral defaults with no literal machine-specific or worktree paths.
The frozen analysis command must reproduce with unchanged percentiles and the --current-since filter must correctly select the frozen current-regime cohort.
